subject: Insurance
title: The Asbestos Liability Crisis
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Asbestos Liability Crisis.

hook.text: Asbestos lawsuits are the longest-running insurance disaster in history.

buildup.text: Millions of workers were exposed to asbestos from the 1940s-1980s.

discovery.text: Insurers argued old policies didn't anticipate asbestos claims.

twist.text: Over 100 companies went bankrupt from asbestos liability.

climax.text: Asbestos taught insurers about 'long-tail' liability—risks that emerge decades after the policy was written.

punchline.text: $100 billion in claims over 50 years. Asbestos is insurance's longest nightmare.

quiz.question: What concept did asbestos claims introduce to insurance?
